map.核心公式：像素 = 物理英寸 × DPI，物理英寸 = 厘米 ÷ 2.54。所以: The core formula: pixels = physical inches × DPI, and physical inches = centimetres ÷ 2.54. So physical centimetres = pixels ÷ DPI × 2.54. The same pixel value maps to different physical sizes at different DPIs, so always fix the DPI before calculating for print.
map.设计稿以像素标注（如 1920×1080 px），交付印刷或喷绘物料时需要换算成: Design files are annotated in pixels (such as 1920×1080 px); when delivering print or large-format material this must be converted to centimetres/millimetres, giving the physical size at the target DPI.
map.：宽度像素 1920、高度 1080、DPI 96。英寸 = 像素 / DPI，: : width 1920 pixels, height 1080 pixels, 96 DPI. Inches = pixels / DPI and centimetres = inches × 2.54. The width = 1920/96×2.54 ≈ 50.8 cm and the height = 1080/96×2.54 ≈ 28.6 cm. Printed at 300 DPI the same size needs 6000×3375 px.
